description: This Python module provides a cross-platform implementation of a monotonic clock function named 'monotonic'. It attempts to use the standard library 'time.monotonic' if available, otherwise falls back to platform-specific implementations using ctypes to access system APIs for macOS, Windows, Linux, and other Unix-like systems. The code includes detailed platform checks and fallback mechanisms to ensure a monotonic clock is provided across different operating systems.

classes.description: Structure representing time with seconds and nanoseconds, used with clock_gettime.
